mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An annualized CPI increase exceeding 3.0% signals inflationary pressure that prompts central bank tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 0.5% monthly and unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it indicates a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in < 40% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, housing starts (HOUST) below 550.0 thousand units signal a weakening real estate sector that dampens consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in < 40% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST < 550.0.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing production index (INDPRO) above 100.0 indicates robust industrial activity that often precedes central bank tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in < 40% of instances when INDPRO > 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% indicates restrictive monetary policy that deters speculative investment and encourages capital preservation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansions, a GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 0.5% and housing starts (HOUST) above 550.0 thousand units indicate robust consumer demand and construction activity, fueling corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in < 40% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 0.5% and HOUST > 550.0.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of labor market slack, an unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals weak consumer spending and reduced corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in < 40% of instances during labor market slack when UNRATE > 5.0%.
